description: We are OPTIMUS, computer engineering students from Yaounde passionate about data, AI and Earth observation. We are tackling the MODIS/VIIRS hotspot challenge: a web app that harmonizes 20+ years of satellite fire data into a burning-activity calendar, with a focus on Central Africa’s seasonal fires. We bring data engineering, ML/forecasting and full-stack skills. Looking for: front-end & data viz, design & storytelling, and Earth science profiles. Join us!
